content.name: Expertise
entries: You gain {@variantrule Expertise|SRD52} in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice. {@skill Performance|SRD52} and {@skill Persuasion|SRD52} are recommended if you have proficiency in them.
At Bard level 9, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|SRD52} in two more of your skill proficiencies of your choice.
